modmenu.summaryTranslation.emberframe: More FPS with shaders on Vulkan, especially with lots of mobs.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.emberfram: Optimizes Minecraft with Vitrail on Vulkan: faster mobs and mob shadows, without changing the image.
emberframe.notice.not_vulkan: The game is running on %s, not Vulkan. Emberframe only speeds up the Vulkan renderer and does nothing here. Switch to Vulkan in the video settings and restart Minecraft.
emberframe.notice.switch_question:
Emberframe cannot run on %s, it only speeds up the Vulkan renderer. Would you like to switch to Vulkan?
This closes the game, just start it again afterwards.
emberframe.option.fast_entity_data.toolt: Leaves out mob data the active shader pack does not read. Checks the pack itself.
emberframe.option.reuse_entity_states.to: Uses a mob's state from the same frame for its shadow too.
emberframe.option.pause_menu_fps.tooltip: FPS limit in the pause menu. 0 or far left = no limit.
emberframe.option.adaptive_scale.tooltip: Lowers the world resolution when FPS drop below the target. Needs Vitrail and a shader pack.
emberframe.option.adaptive_target_fps.to: Below this the resolution is lowered. This is not an FPS limit.
emberframe.option.adaptive_min_scale.too: It never goes lower than this.
emberframe.option.game_monitor.tooltip: 1 = main monitor, 2 = second monitor. Takes effect on the next start.
